author: Catta Team
description: Public Catta Monthly Events: server-owned countdown and timed gameplay, per-chat Event Lorebook and missions. Prelaunch members see only Halloween event information and the server countdown; full controls appear only after Event opens. Five-minute in-memory UI cache, ten-minute leaderboard refresh, Discord display names verified through Cafe Hub, ten ranked players per page, and score-only updates between messages. Client observations now support volatile Lorebooks. Member and admin permissions remain server-owned. No player-facing Admin Studio or legacy cleanup button. Admin management stays separate. Casa carrot awards require a separate admin approval in /setupeventmm, with server-side duplicate protection. No instant automatic payout; Discord member DMs remain disabled.
